department: School of Physics, Chemistry and Earth Sciences

deadline.value: Applications can be made at any time of the year. Scholarship rounds have their own dates.
deadline.quote: Applications to study a research degree at Adelaide University are open, and you can apply at any time of the year

gre_subject.value: The Adelaide pages reviewed do not mention a subject GRE for this field.

supervisor.value: You need written supervisory support from an eligible principal supervisor before you apply, and admission depends on a supervisory panel being available.
supervisor.quote: Before applying for admission and/or scholarship, you will need written confirmation of supervisory support from an eligible principal supervisor

also.quote: admission to a research degree at Adelaide University is conditional on the availability of a suitable supervisory panel

funding.value: Scholarships are open in every discipline but are competitive, so funding is not guaranteed.
funding.quote: Available in every discipline area to support outstanding candidates pursuing a Doctor of Philosophy

entry_route.value: Either a research Master's or a four-year Bachelor (Honours) is accepted. The Honours route needs a WAM of 65 or more and at least half a year of research training at WAM 75 or more.
entry_route.quote: A Master degree by research (AQF level 9)

notes: Chemistry is a listed PhD study area of the school.
